title: Replace characters in a file using tr
summary: Use the `tr` command to find and replace specific characters in a text file. It reads the file, swaps the characters, and prints the result to your screen.

steps.explain: Read the file and replace the first character with the second. The result is printed to the terminal; it does not modify the original file unless you redirect the output.

placeholders.name: REPLACE_CHARACTER
placeholders.description: The character to replace it with

alternatives.explain: Replace characters in the output of another command (like echo) instead of a file.
